core_categories: Pharmaceutical Distribution; Medical Devices; Parapharmacy; Dermocosmetics; Veterinary Medicines; Logistics
specialty_focus: Hefame is a Spanish pharmaceutical distribution cooperative that supplies medicines, medical devices, and parapharmacy products to pharmacies. It specializes in B2B cooperative support, including centralized purchasing, digitalization, and temperature-controlled logistics. Hefame does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
